Title: who controls a retainer/equipment that had been moved/placed on other player

Messages.Author: ulph
Messages.Body:
Maybe this is buried in the rulings ot rulebook, but my quick search yeilded nothing.

I wonder if cards like The Swarm, Llomba, Wooden Stake are considered to be cobtrolled by the owner of the minion they are currently attached to, or whoever put them into play.

cheers

Swarm
Animal with 1 life. Requires a Laibon.
Put the Swarm on any ready minion (this is a +1 stealth  action if that minion is controlled by another Methuselah). If this action is blocked, put the Swarm on this acting minion instead (no cost is paid). If the Swarm has 2 or more life during employer's unlock phase, it burns 1 life; otherwise, it steals 1 blood or life from employer. A minion can have only one Swarm.

Ilomba
Animal with 1 life. Requires a Laibon. Put Ilomba on any minion (this is a +1 stealth  action if that minion is controlled by another Methuselah). If Ilomba would burn a life (or would otherwise be burned), this minion burns a blood or life instead. If he or she cannot, he or she is burned. A minion may have only one Ilomba.

Wooden Stake
Melee weapon.
Strike: strength damage. If 2 or more damage is succesfully inflicted on an opposing vampire by this weapon in a given combat, that vampire is sent to torpor, this card is moved to that vampire, and he or she does not unlock as normal as long as he or she remains in torpor.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
1.6.3. Minion Cards
By default, a minion card in play is controlled by the controller of the minion it is on.

Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:

> 1.6.3. Minion Cards
> By default, a minion card in play is controlled by the controller of the minion it is on.

So how are the exceptions handled? Specifically in cases where a card is placed on somebody elses minion, but the player who played it is ousted. EG. How is fame different? Or have we played wrong and fame is not removed when its original player gets ousted?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Bloodartist wrote:
>
> > Ankha wrote:
> > 1.6.3. Minion Cards
> > By default, a minion card in play is controlled by the controller of the minion it is on.
> >

>
The card explicitely states otherwise, as usual.
E.g., Mind Rape: "you still control this card"

> Bloodartist wrote:
> Specifically in cases where a card is placed on somebody elses minion, but the player who played it is ousted.
>
It depends who controls the card.

> Bloodartist wrote:
> EG. How is fame different?
>
Fame is not minion card, it is a master card.
